status: candidate_only_not_public_abi; A owns the public schema, the only production type7 enable decision and the physical board

fields.name: type
fields.notes: candidate fixtures only; the existing A wire.py must keep rejecting type7

fields.name: sequence
fields.notes: frame sequence, not an acquisition index; must increase without wrap inside one binding

fields.name: tick_ms
fields.notes: low 32 bits of the FIRST acquisition tick in this candidate payload

crc.coverage: version byte through the last payload byte

fields.name: revision
fields.notes: candidate revision, distinct from the outer ABI version

bits.0..2: E code 0 maps to 0, 1 to 1, 2 to 2, 3 to 4, 4 to 8; 5..7 invalid
bits.3: RAW flag, RAW requires k bits 0

fields.name: quality
fields.notes: the four quality flags are common to every point of the block; the per-point mask is recovered by expansion

fields.name: significant_bits
fields.notes: includes the 16 anchor bits for any valid block; 0 for quality-only invalid blocks

fields.name: first_index
fields.notes: first ACTUAL acquisition index of the block

fields.name: first_tick_ms
fields.notes: first actual acquisition tick of the block

optional_strides.notes: every point sits at first + i * stride; uint32 index and uint64 tick progression must not overflow

short_form.bound: age <= first_tick (the uint64 origin would underflow otherwise)

held_source_extension.notes: the source update origin is constant for the whole held block; later point ages follow from their ticks

code_section.rice_body: MSB-first bitstream after the anchor: quotient zero bits then a one terminator, then k remainder bits
code_section.padding: unused low bits of the final byte are zero

canonicality.mode_selection: two-stage: stage 1 picks the Rice k with the fewest significant bits, stage 2 keeps Rice only when its padded code-byte count is strictly smaller than RAW 2*value_count bytes; a stored-byte tie selects RAW
canonicality.k_selection: fewest significant bits over legal k 0..15 with every quotient at most 31; ties choose the lowest k - exactly the unchanged inner codec k rule
canonicality.invalid_shape: quality-only invalid blocks carry zero significant bits, no code bytes, RAW with k=0 and no anchor
canonicality.held_forms: short age 1..65535, long absolute source tick only when the age exceeds 65535
canonicality.decode_checks: version, type, magic, exact length, CRC, config_epoch, session, E versus binding, reserved bit, strides, overflow, source forms, and a canonical re-encoding byte comparison of the decoded values

recovery.packing: greedy longest legal prefix; split at quality change, held origin change, stride change, gap, overflow or the 32 B budget; every input point can become a singleton
recovery.sequence_capacity: no partial output is returned when the uint16 sequence range cannot hold every frame; sequence never wraps
recovery.receiver: at most 16 packets cached by sequence; exact duplicates return status duplicate with zero points; the same sequence with different bytes conflicts; a sequence no longer in the cache is rejected; sequence gaps are accepted without synthesizing points; per-channel first index and tick must both exceed that channel high water; failures never partially advance state

differences_from_inner_codec.body_order: candidate anchor and RAW words are little-endian; the inner fixture uses MSB-first bit words
differences_from_inner_codec.mode_rule: both choose Rice k by fewest significant bits (ties lowest k); the inner codec keeps Rice on a bit tie below RAW bits while the candidate then compares STORED BYTES of the whole code section and prefers RAW on a byte tie
differences_from_inner_codec.example: [0, 64] at E0: inner fixture rice k=6, 25 significant bits, 4 stored bytes; candidate RAW, 32 significant bits, 4 stored bytes

ledger_definition.count: decoded point count of the block
ledger_definition.value_count: points with valid true (0 for quality-only blocks)
ledger_definition.selected_raw_bytes: 2 * value_count, the RAW body byte count the stored-byte selection compared against
ledger_definition.significant_bits: code-section bits from the payload field, anchor included
ledger_definition.line_bits_8n1: 10 * frame_bytes, one start bit and one stop bit per byte

limitations: Candidate only; not a public ABI freeze and not implemented in any A/C file; A wire.py keeps rejecting type7.
Extra metadata can expand traffic; no compression, throughput, latency or continuous-sampling claim is made.
Indices are actual per-channel acquisition indices, never frame sequence numbers; equal indices across channels do not prove common sampling time.
No source authentication, calibration, runtime clock acquisition, observation lease, motion authorization or AI feed is provided; the receiver cannot attest handshake, session uniqueness or trust.
Saturation is reported status only and never implies endpoint values.
The uint64 tick and low32 rollover vectors are synthetic future-layout proposals; A reports current ADC ticks at most 2**31-1, multiples of 10, and EM tick values that are multiples of 50 ms.
C must independently decode the approved candidate and adapt source, profile and physical units after A approval.
a_approval_gates: candidate field packing and revision byte
header tick rule: low 32 bits of the first acquisition tick
per-channel acquisition index meaning and C four-channel grouping
held source origin and short/long form canonicality
stage-two stored-byte RAW tie policy and little-endian body adaptation
full BOOT digest and the actual TRACE scheduling and sliding-window budget
